name: 07456 · Ringwood, NJ
findings: ZIP 07456 (Ringwood) has 46 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07456 (Ringwood) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 07456 (Ringwood) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 69% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 22 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.
